sentences: A young woman stands behind the bar at the Folies-Bergère, one of the most glittering music halls in Paris.
The chandeliers and the crowd behind her are all a reflection in a huge mirror, which means the noisy room is really on our side of the bar.
Yet her reflected back has slipped far off to the right, where she seems to face a male customer.
That misplaced reflection has been argued over ever since the picture was first shown in 1882.
In the top left corner, the green-booted feet of a trapeze artist dangle into view, and the marble counter holds champagne, oranges and bottles of English beer marked with a red triangle.
The model was Suzon, a real barmaid there, who posed in Manet's studio.
It was his last major painting, finished a year before he died.
